name: TestAutomationFramework
summary: Provides the mechanisms tests are written against, so that a test states its intent rather than its plumbing.

roles.name: TestAutomationFramework
roles.summary: The framework a team wrote, or the one it wraps. Annotating it draws the line a codebase most often loses: what belongs to the harness and what belongs to a test — because a helper that has drifted into the framework is one nobody dares change, and a framework rule that has drifted into a test is one nobody finds.
